line: R50 amendment A2 (registered before any R50 formal unit; after the first Flickr smokes / re-reads, which are rerun under it)

env.NPY_DISABLE_CPU_FEATURES: AVX512F AVX512CD AVX512_SKX AVX512_CLX AVX512_CNL AVX512_ICL AVX512_SPR

tie_policy.rule: numpy runtime dispatch without AVX-512 in every R50 process (sbatch export + in-unit assert in r50ext P): the evaluator (native_eval i2t/t2i = upstream np.argsort, default kind) then orders exactly tied DEV scores identically on AVX-512 and non-AVX-512 nodes

reason: Every DEV row of the peer-mean native score matrix has exact ties (fp32 shard products stored in fp64: 1014/1014 i2t rows). numpy 2.2.6 dispatches argsort to an AVX-512 kernel on AVX-512 CPUs, which orders ties differently: the same R50 n60 cache gives H rSum 496.331 on AVX-512 nodes (RTX nodes, nodecpu04) and 496.233 on node52 (no AVX-512) or with AVX-512 disabled; this is also the ~0.1 R47 (496.627, node50) vs R48 (496.529, node52) H difference on one cache noted by the package. Code bytes of the evaluator unchanged; the build manifests keep their AVX-512-dispatch H records; all PRIMARY readouts (units, re-reads, H table) are taken under A2.
